mutants.why: '..' anywhere is a directory-traversal escape and must be rejected even without a separator; dropping the check accepts 'foo..esd'. isSafeAria2FileEntry_rejectsPathTraversal asserts !isSafeAria2FileEntry({fileName="foo..esd"}) (a name with no '/', '\\', or ':' so only this predicate can catch it)

a '/' in the out= name escapes the download directory; dropping the check accepts 'sub/core.esd'. isSafeAria2FileEntry_rejectsPathSeparators asserts !isSafeAria2FileEntry({fileName="sub/core.esd"}) (contains '/' only, no '..'/'\\'/':')

a '\\' in the out= name escapes the download directory on Windows; dropping the check accepts 'sub\\core.esd'. isSafeAria2FileEntry_rejectsPathSeparators asserts !isSafeAria2FileEntry({fileName="sub\\core.esd"}) (contains '\\' only)

a ':' selects a drive or NTFS alternate data stream; dropping the check accepts 'core.esd:zone'. isSafeAria2FileEntry_rejectsDriveOrAds asserts !isSafeAria2FileEntry({fileName="core.esd:zone"}) (contains ':' only, ':' is not a control char so nothing else re-catches it)

Windows trims a trailing dot so the on-disk name differs from the integrity-checked name; dropping the check accepts 'core.esd.'. isSafeAria2FileEntry_rejectsTrailingDotOrSpace asserts !isSafeAria2FileEntry({fileName="core.esd."}) (no '..', base 'core' not reserved, only this predicate applies)

Windows trims a trailing space so the on-disk name differs from the integrity-checked name; dropping the check accepts 'core.esd '. isSafeAria2FileEntry_rejectsTrailingDotOrSpace asserts !isSafeAria2FileEntry({fileName="core.esd "}) (0x20 is printable so the control-char scan does not re-catch it)

a reserved DOS device name (CON/NUL/COM1...) makes aria2 open a device instead of a file; dropping the check accepts 'CON.esd'. isSafeAria2FileEntry_rejectsReservedDeviceName asserts !isSafeAria2FileEntry({fileName="CON.esd"}) (and 'nul', 'COM1.txt')

0x20 (space) is the first PRINTABLE code unit and must be allowed inside a field; relaxing '<' to '<=' misclassifies an internal space as a control char and rejects a legal name. isSafeAria2FileEntry_controlCharBoundary asserts isSafeAria2FileEntry({fileName="core update.esd"}) == true

0x7f (DEL) is a control char that must be rejected; dropping the '== 0x7f' term (the '< 0x20' term does not cover it) accepts a DEL in the name. isSafeAria2FileEntry_controlCharBoundary asserts !isSafeAria2FileEntry({fileName="core\x7f.esd"})

a CR/LF/TAB/NUL in the file name could break out of the aria2 record; forcing this term true stops scanning the name. isSafeAria2FileEntry_rejectsControlCharInFileName asserts !isSafeAria2FileEntry({fileName="core\n.esd"}) (name is otherwise safe so only the control-char scan rejects it)

CRLF in the URL could inject an out=/uri directive into the manifest; forcing this term true stops scanning the URL. isSafeAria2FileEntry_rejectsControlCharInUrl asserts !isSafeAria2FileEntry({url="...x\r\n out=/etc/passwd"}) with fileName and sha1 safe

a control char in the checksum field is serialized into the manifest too; forcing this term true stops scanning sha1. isSafeAria2FileEntry_rejectsControlCharInSha1 asserts !isSafeAria2FileEntry({sha1="da39...afd8\n0709"}) with fileName and url safe
